title: Tahta Kabeneran
intro: Saurang pamingpin anu kuat, anu kawéntar ku kawijaksanaan anu hébat sareng tahta anu megah, nampi pesen misterius ti sumber anu teu dipikanyaho. Komunikasi anu teu disangka-sangka ieu nangtang kapercayaan sareng otoritasna, ngajantenkeun aranjeunna dina perjalanan diplomatik anu bakal nguji intelekna sareng pamustunganana ngarah kana hudang spiritual anu jero. Naha anjeun tiasa ngungkabkeun idéntitas daulat ieu sareng kajadian anu ngarobih sakumna karajaanana?
clues: Abdi sareng rahayat abdi nyembah panonpoé, nuturkeun adat istiadat karuhun abdi.
Manuk, manuk hoopoe, téh siga utusan nu teu disangka-sangka nu mawa surat ti pamingpin nu boga kakawasaan.
Pikeun nguji kawijaksanaan nu ngirim, kuring ngirimkeun hadiah anu berharga, tapi dibales deui, sabab nu ngirimna miboga kakayaan anu jauh leuwih gede ti Allah.
Sateuacan kuring nepi ka karaton anu ngirim surat, tahta kuring anu megah sacara ajaib diangkut ka dinya dina sakeudeung panon.
Nalika kuring sumping, kuring ditanya naha tahta anu diangkut éta milik kuring, teras kuring ngawaler, 'Sigana éta téh singgasana anu leres.'
Kuring asup ka hiji rohangan ageung anu lanténa ku kuring disangka balong cai, sarta dina momen kagum éta, kuring pasrahkeun diri bareng jeung Nabi Sulaiman ka Allah, Pangeran sakumna alam.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
